row:
Wilderness TV is a channel about rescuing and caring for animals, and building safe, beautiful homes for them by hand using mud, clay, and natural materials.

On this channel, I rescue puppies, dogs, cats, rabbits, and other animals from unsafe places, then create peaceful environments where they can live comfortably. Every house, shelter, and playground is built with simple tools and traditional techniques, inspired by ancient and natural building skills.

My purpose is to show people around the world that animals deserve protection, care, and love. Through these projects, I also share my creativity and ideas for pet house building, animal shelters, and outdoor animal spaces.

All animals in my videos are cared for responsibly and live in a safe countryside environment near me, not in the wild jungle.

Thank you for supporting animal rescue and handmade building projects.
